overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna features seven strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and enhanced circulation. With its advanced chromotherapy lighting and red light therapy, this sauna transforms any indoor space—be it a basement, master bath, or fitness room—into a personal sanctuary. Enjoy the convenience of Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity, ensuring a truly immersive and relaxing experience.
